description: Velocx NZ is a performance swimwear retailer bringing elite global brands to New Zealand swimmers. Featuring Jaked, a premium Italian swimwear brand trusted by competitive athletes, Velocx helps swimmers train harder, race faster, and perform at their best.
tone: authoritative yet energetic, performance-driven, confident, aspirational, community-focused, athlete-first mindset

brand_positioning.velocx_role: trusted curator and performance authority in NZ swimwear
brand_positioning.jaked_positioning: elite Italian performance swimwear designed for competitive swimmers and race performance

target_audience.primary: competitive swimmers and triathletes in New Zealand aged 16–40
target_audience.secondary: fitness swimmers and aspiring athletes who want high-performance gear
target_audience.entry_level: younger swimmers or beginners influenced by elite athlete content
psychographics: wants to improve performance and times
inspired by elite athletes and competition
cares about quality gear and progression

content_pillars.details: tips, drills, technique breakdowns, race strategies
show Jaked in action, benefits, performance angles, not hard selling
adapt TikTok/IG trends into swimming niche

content_types.description: strong 1-3 second hook, problem or POV-based
show Jaked during training or racing naturally
explain why performance swimwear matters (without hard selling)

_note: Instagram and TikTok are in platforms config but credentials not yet configured. Update 'platforms' array and add credentials to config/credentials/velocx_nz.env when ready.

optimal_times: 03:00 NZST — top-performing post in the full analysis period (engagement 4, image post) was published at this exact hour; confirmed as the highest-engagement posting window in Facebook insights best_posting_hours data; likely catching early morning swimmers pre-training and late-night scrollers; use for highest-priority image posts each week

23:00 NZST — second-best performing hour in Facebook insights best_posting_hours data; second-ranked top post (engagement 2) published at 23:14; evening wind-down browsing window for athletes post-training; use for secondary image posts

21:00 NZST — third-best performing hour in Facebook insights best_posting_hours data; third and fourth ranked posts (engagement 1 each) published at 21:28 and 21:01; consistent with post-training evening engagement window; use for supporting content when 03:00 and 23:00 slots are filled
best_days: Sunday to Thursday evenings — aligns with optimal posting hours identified from Facebook insights; training days drive scroll behaviour in recovery windows; insufficient day-level data to rank with confidence; low confidence on specific day preference — review after 4 additional weeks of varied-day publishing to establish day-level signal
top_content_types: race_action — used twice in archive and present in top-performing posts; cinematic dive starts, mid-stroke butterfly or freestyle, underwater dolphin kick with water exploding, Jaked cap visible; aligns with highest-engagement post types in archive and confirmed by May 2026 trend research as top-performing visual format in competitive swim niche; prioritise as primary image type

training — early morning empty pool with single swimmer, coach on deck, athlete drilling in lane; post-nationals training block now underway per NZ swim event calendar; autumn/winter indoor training focus confirmed as high-relevance seasonal angle across multiple research briefs; cinematic underwater action viewed from below with crepuscular light rays is the specific trending visual variant per April 2026 visual research brief

gear_closeup — sleek Jaked racing suit submerged in deep teal pool water with dramatic orange-amber overhead spotlights; fabric texture and compression panelling detail visible; used only once in archive (underutilised) and recommended as highest-traction format for performance sports brands in 2026 trend research; post-nationals period remains a high-purchase-intent window for race suit quality messaging; increase to at least one dedicated post per week

lifestyle — athlete poolside post-session, towel around shoulders, focused intense expression, warm stadium lighting, wet hair; autumn training mood resonates with seasonal content confirmed across multiple research briefs; portrait composition with subject in upper 60% of frame per brand composition rules
top_pillars: Swim Performance and Training — stat-backed educational tip posts with surprising data hooks are the highest-engagement content type on Facebook in 2026 per all five research briefs; save-worthy step-by-step drill breakdowns with bullet structure are driving saves and shares above all other formats; undeployed high-priority angles include six-beat kick (10.21% 50m improvement stat), hip rotation (10 degrees = longer stroke and less drag), and pull buoy dependency; this pillar should anchor at least 2 posts per week with image format

Jaked Product Integration — post-nationals period confirmed by multiple research briefs as prime window for race suit quality and performance fabric messaging; gear_closeup format remains underused in archive (1 use of 27 posts) and is highly recommended by 2026 platform trend data; suit compression science and hydrodynamics framing outperforms pure product showcase per April 2026 research; increase to at least 1 dedicated product post per week using cinematic fabric detail imagery

Athlete Mindset and Motivation — sports psychology and mental performance content confirmed outperforming technique-only posts for competitive swimming audiences in 2025–2026 per April 2026 research; mental toughness in the final 50m and taper mindset angles are undeployed and high-relevance; must be anchored to a specific technique, stat, or NZ swim context to avoid low-performing generic motivational format

Trends and Viral Formats — photo carousel formats gaining traction in niche sports communities on Instagram in 2026; challenge-based viral swimming content driving team participation and exponential sharing per April 2026 research; this pillar remains underutilised in the archive and represents the highest growth lever on Instagram and TikTok; test one carousel or trend-adapted post per week

voice_guide.headline_style: short punchy, 2–5 words, imperative or bold statement
voice_guide.caption_style: hook first, story/value middle, soft CTA at end — no hashtags in body

image_style.description: Dark, moody, cinematic — professional sports/editorial photography quality
photography_style: dark moody cinematic — not bright or cheerful
rich deep blue/teal pool water as primary background colour
dramatic overhead or side lighting creating strong highlights and deep shadows
high contrast — subjects pop against dark surroundings
motion blur or frozen-motion water droplets add energy
shallow depth of field — subject sharp, background softly blurred
avoid: smiling lifestyle shots (we want focused, competitive, intense)
any competing brand logos on suits, caps, or equipment
composition_rules: bottom-centre area should be darker/less detailed — VelocX logo is overlaid there
leave breathing room — don't crowd every corner
portrait images: subject in upper 60%, pool/water fills lower portion
landscape images: subject left or centre, water/pool atmosphere right

color_palette.accent_lighting: warm orange-amber #F8A30E from stadium overhead spots
color_palette.athlete_skin: warm highlighted tones against dark water
color_palette.suit: sleek dark racing suit, no visible competing brand logos

image_style.prompt_base: dark cinematic indoor pool, dramatic orange-amber overhead spotlights, deep teal water, high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, professional sports photography, bottom area dark for text overlay

image_types.race_action: athlete mid-stroke (butterfly, breaststroke, freestyle), race dive off blocks, underwater dolphin kick, finish wall touch. Water exploding around the body. Jaked swim cap visible.
image_types.training: athlete drilling in lane, coach on deck, early morning empty pool with single swimmer, pull buoy, paddles
image_types.gear_closeup: sleek racing swimsuit flat lay on pool tiles or submerged in water, goggles with pool reflection, Jaked cap detail. Deep blue/teal water as backdrop.
image_types.lifestyle: athlete poolside post-session, towel around shoulders, focused expression, warm stadium lighting, wet hair
image_types.open_water: New Zealand coastal swim, ocean or harbour, dramatic sky, wetsuit or racing kit
image_types.team: swim club warm-up, lane full of swimmers, coach briefing athletes pre-race
